overview_description.description:
Reflex Robotics is building affordable ($10k) humanoid robots to automate dangerous and repetitive tasks in logistics & manufacturing. We envision a future where everyone has their own humanoid robot that can do the boring stuff and help them focus on more fulfilling work.

Our robots are designed & built in-house by an engineering team that led development of the Stretch robot at Boston Dynamics & key parts of the Model S,X,Y production line at Tesla.
